explication: ExpressLRS is embedded radio-control link firmware for transmitter and receiver hardware, with a browser-based device interface. The main runtime path is transmitter radio-link processing over the air to receiver processing, then CRSF routing to configured peripherals; the README documents additional receiver outputs and user-facing capabilities. The source excerpts show the transmitter/receiver entry points, shared protocol/router behavior, and part of the web app’s loading flow. Other capability branches are included from README statements; unsampled wiring is not inferred.
